title: Role callers with a bucket policy
question: Does the simulator use a resource-based policy when the caller is a role? AWS says "Simulation of resource-based policies isn't supported for IAM roles", which could mean roles' own trust policies, or any resource-based policy when a role is the caller. In each case the bucket policy should decide the answer, so it should show up in MatchedStatements.

cases.name: bucket_policy_grants_to_the_role
cases.description: The bucket policy grants the role read access. The role has no identity policy that allows it, and no boundary.

documented.source: For most resources, you only need an explicit Allow for the principal in either an identity-based policy or a resource-based policy to grant access.

cases.name: bucket_policy_denies_everyone
cases.description: The role's identity policy allows S3, and the bucket policy denies everyone.

documented.source: If the enforcement code finds even one explicit deny that applies, the enforcement code returns a final decision of Deny.
